whale: a photo of a humpback whale in the ocean
a whale's dorsal fin above the water
a whale's tail fluke above the water
the back of a whale at the sea surface
person: a photo of a person on a boat
a person wearing a hat and sunglasses
railing: a photo of a boat railing
the metal railing of a boat
the deck and rail of a small boat
land: a photo of an island seen from the sea
a photo of land on the horizon
vessel: a photo of a boat on the ocean
water: a photo of empty ocean water and sky
a photo of the sea surface with nothing on it

photo_rule: CLIP: mean of the normalised prompt embeddings per class; softmax over the six classes at the model's logit scale; main class = argmax; class present = p >= 0.2.
box_rule: OWLv2 on the 2560-px photo (model input 960); a detection counts at score >= 0.2 (fixed); photo-level presence of a class = any detection of it at >= 0.2; best score per class kept for a descriptive sweep only.
instance_rule: CLIP on each pipeline instance's square crop (box x 1.15, as the not-whale filter cuts it): softmax over the six photo classes; instance name = argmax.
railing_colour_rule: On the 2560-px photo: HSV, saturation >= 0.45 and value >= 0.25; hue bands red <15 or >=165 (OpenCV 0-180), green 40-85, blue 95-130; the marker colour = the band with the most pixels if that band holds >= 0.5 % of the photo and >= 2x the next band; else none. Fixed before looking at the marker photos' pixel values.
